prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: pale cyan. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: pale cyan.
Subjects: paper coins; a torn-paper arrow.
Opens on the open pair, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip is covered as the open pair collapses into paper coins; a torn-paper arrow enters beneath and points up.
Ends holding on the arrow.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "WALLET SHARE".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "WALLET SHARE". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "One vendor, broader suite, more of each customer's wallet.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Modern editorial paper collage style, Static Shot filmed flat under soft upper-left light. The frame begins on <Picture 1>, featuring a pale cyan paper ground with two torn-paper cutouts—a blank card and a monitor—under a cream headline reading "2 WORKFLOWS". An English narrator (S1, adult male, warm, clear, brisk cadence) speaks in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[English] One vendor, broader suite, more of each customer's wallet.</d> Immediately, a new cream paper chip firmly drops over the old headline with a slight bounce, clearly displaying the black sans-serif text "WALLET SHARE". In the lower two-thirds, the card and monitor cutouts collapse inward, transforming into a stack of unmarked black-and-white halftone paper coins with rough torn edges. By 00:02.500, a bold torn-paper arrow slides rapidly up from the bottom edge, pointing upward at the coins. The elements settle cleanly into place and hold with subtle paper texture presence through 00:05.000.

overall_soundscape: Tactile foley of sliding cardstock, crisp paper-slaps, and dry paper rustling synchronized to the arrivals of the headline chip, coin cutouts, and arrow over a quiet room tone.
